name: cache-control-input
title: Cache Control Input
description: Reads back who stores the response and for how long (browser, CDN via CDN-Cache-Control or Surrogate-Control, other shared caches) and flags per-user pages a CDN can cache, public cookie-setting responses, no-cache mistaken for no-store, unsafe immutable and missing Vary.

meta.stops: Private page cached by the CDN
meta.summary: Reads back who will store a response and for how long, so a per-user page isn't cached by the CDN and HTML isn't stuck for days.
catches: Personalised pages that a CDN or shared cache may store
Responses that set a cookie but are marked public
no-cache used where no-store was meant
immutable on URLs without a content hash, and long max-age on HTML
A missing Vary for compressed or negotiated bodies; one-tap fixes for each
limits: Reads the header text you give it; real CDN behaviour also depends on its own configuration
Whether a page is personalised and the URL path are inputs you provide
Vendor-specific headers beyond CDN-Cache-Control and Surrogate-Control are not modelled
a11y: Labelled textarea with aria-invalid and aria-describedby to a role="status" summary
Readback is a section labelled by its heading
After a fix, focus moves to the next fix button or back to the field
Severity is shown with icons and text, not colour alone

rules.note: Informational; check the official source and your CDN's documentation. Surrogate-Control handling follows vendor convention and was not checked against a standard.
